levels.title: Stem Trimming & 45° Angle Cut
levels.skill_name: Condition fresh flower stems for maximum vase life
levels.goal: Prune thorns and cut 5 garden rose stems strictly at a 45° angle with clean floral shears
levels.instruction: Walk to the Pruning & Cutting Bench and press [SPACE] to set cut angle to 45° and strip lower foliage.
customerProfiles: Bride inspecting stem hydration for wedding centerpiece
successConditions: All 5 stems sliced cleanly at 40°–50° without vascular crushing
Bottom 10cm stripped of foliage to prevent waterline bacteria
Stems immediately immersed in fresh floral preservative
steps: Take fresh rose stems from cooler to cutting bench
Gently strip lower leaves and thorns using thorn stripper
Position floral shears at 45° angle and make a clean diagonal slice
Place trimmed stems into prepared hydration bucket

levels.title: Spiral Hand-Tied Bouquet Composition
levels.skill_name: Assemble botanical balance using the Dutch spiral technique
levels.goal: Rotate stems in a continuous spiral to create a domed bouquet with focal garden roses and eucalyptus foliage
levels.instruction: Visit Flower Cooler to gather focal flowers and greenery, then arrange them at the Kraft Wrapping Table.
customerProfiles: Customer seeking romantic hand-tied anniversary bouquet
successConditions: Stems form a balanced 360° self-standing spiral
Focal flowers distributed at varied heights
Bouquet securely tied without bruising delicate stems
steps: Select primary focal roses and secondary textural eucalyptus
Add stems one by one at a consistent 30° angle in a clockwise spiral
Check balance from all sides in mirror
Secure binding point firmly with natural jute twine

levels.title: Resolve Flower Shortage with Harmonious Substitute
levels.skill_name: Handle out-of-stock premium florals with botanical harmony
levels.goal: Explain peony shortage to customer and substitute with open garden roses of matching blush palette
levels.instruction: Check Flower Cooler to confirm zero peonies, then propose blush garden roses at the Checkout Counter.
customerProfiles: Client requesting peonies in late autumn when out of season
successConditions: Customer educated courteously on seasonal availability
steps: Check inventory cooler and verify peony stockout
Explain: 'Peonies are out of season, but our David Austin garden roses offer the same lush, ruffled petal count'
Present fresh blush garden rose blooms for client approval

rules: Cut stems underwater or at a 45-degree angle to prevent air embolisms
Strip foliage below the waterline to prevent bacterial rot
Maintain floral cooler temperature between 2°C and 4°C
